findings.title: ppt-web-ui: ProtectedRoute hardcodes English 'Access Denied' / 'Loading...' strings instead of using i18n
evidence: frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/components/ProtectedRoute.tsx:106 — literal 'Loading...' text with no useTranslation/t() call
frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/components/ProtectedRoute.tsx:125-126 — user-facing role-denied page hardcodes 'Access Denied' and 'You do not have permission to access this page.' in English

Sibling AuthRequiredGate.tsx:21-23 already translates the equivalent gate strings via t('errors.authenticationRequired') / t('errors.missingOrgContext'), confirming this is an oversight — non-English users see raw English on the access-denied and auth-loading paths

findings.title: ppt-web-ui: OfflineIndicator banner text is hardcoded English, not i18n
evidence: frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/components/OfflineIndicator.tsx:58-60 — 'You are offline. Some features may be unavailable.' rendered as a literal string

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/components/OfflineIndicator.tsx:89 — 'Connection restored' rendered as a literal string; component imports no useTranslation, so both aria-live banners are English-only for all locales (sk/cs/de/en)
